name: model-policy
description: Opus runs only in the main session. Subagents run on Sonnet at most, and on Haiku for lookups and mechanical edits.

askModelAtStart.title: Ask which model to use at session start
askModelAtStart.description: Ask for Opus, Sonnet or Haiku when a new session starts. The pick becomes the main model. Haiku also runs every agent on Haiku.

workflowConfirmAtPercent.title: Confirm workflows at 5-hour percent
workflowConfirmAtPercent.description: From this 5-hour usage percent on, the person must confirm each Workflow the main session starts.
